verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs name a first-party tool for this story: Migration Assistant for setting up a new Mac "even if you're migrating from Windows". The Mac Help switcher guide also explicitly covers "how to transfer your files from your PC." Setup Assistant can additionally carry over Wi-Fi and Apple Account sign-in from a nearby iPhone. missing for 10: explicit documentation that settings (not just files) migrate, detail on what Migration Assistant transfers and how, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration experience.
